name: bitHuman
description:
Real-time, lip-synced AI avatars: audio in, talking video out — on
the cloud, on your own hardware, or in the browser. This is the REST
contract; the guides, the SDKs and the CLI are on
[docs.bithuman.ai](https://docs.bithuman.ai).

All endpoints are relative to `https://api.bithuman.ai` and
require an `api-secret` header.
[Get an API secret →](https://www.bithuman.ai/developer/api-keys)

This machine-readable spec covers the developer surface. Two groups
are documented only in the markdown guides, not here:
[organizations](https://docs.bithuman.ai/api/organizations)
(`/v2/organizations*`, `/v2/agents/{agent_code}/share-org`) and the
[Realtime WebSocket relay](https://docs.bithuman.ai/api/realtime)
(`wss://api.bithuman.ai/v1/realtime`). Purely internal / infrastructure routes —
webhook receivers, `/func_*` generation internals, health/telemetry,
and realtime session plumbing — are excluded entirely: they are not
part of the public developer contract and may change without notice.
